primary_source.title: Verified Tool Calls Improve LLM Agent Reliability Under Non-Atomic Failures
primary_scope_verified_from_arxiv_record: The proposed mechanism is a verification-aware wrapper around external tool calls.
The wrapper combines postcondition verification, verify-before-retry logic, and idempotency keys.
Evaluation is in a controlled simulated environment with injected non-atomic failures across multiple task templates.
The reported primary conclusion is reduced duplicate actions while maintaining comparable task success rates.
